name: Stromal extracellular matrix with integrin and syndecan adhesion
rationale: Members describe the fibroblast/stromal ECM programme (ECM modules, collagen/TGFB, EMT, fibroblast proliferation); integrin and syndecan cell-surface adhesion distinguish it from the YAP/TAZ mechanoresponsive, fibronectin/collagen-receptor and collagen-degradation neighbours.

name: Phosphatase feedback on MAPK and IL-6–STAT3 signalling
rationale: Members share negative feedback on ERK/JNK/p38 by Thr/Tyr dephosphorylation together with IL-6/STAT3 and AP-1 outputs, which separates the theme from neighbours focused on TAK1-driven JNK/p38 activation, ERK5/Ras braking or immediate-early growth arrest.

name: Hematopoietic stem cell maintenance and bone marrow cellularity
rationale: All members concern HSC homeostasis, proliferation and differentiation and bone marrow cell number, proliferation and apoptosis, distinguishing it from neighbours about stem cell division/LIF, lineage-restricting differentiation or thymic T cell development.

name: Congenital N-glycosylation disorders of precursor supply and Golgi processing
rationale: All members are CDGs, here from defects in mannose/dolichol precursor supply and utilisation (MPI, PMM2, DOLK, SRD5A3, MPDU1, RFT1) and Golgi glycan processing (MGAT2, B4GALT1), unlike neighbours centred on ALG glycosyltransferases, DPM synthesis or GPI anchoring.

name: C-type lectin antifungal sensing and IL-12/23/17/10 cytokines
rationale: Members combine Dectin-1/Dectin-2/DC-SIGN fungal recognition with production and signalling of IL-12, IL-23, IL-17, IL-10, IL-27/35 and related cytokines; the lectin/fungal arm and Th17 axis distinguish it from neighbours on IL-37, IL-33/type III IFN, IL-18 or protozoan responses.

qualifier: driven by intracellular domains of NOTCH1–4
name: Notch intracellular domain–driven target gene transcription
rationale: All members concern transcriptional output of Notch intracellular domains (NOTCH1–4 NICD, HLH targets, constitutive NOTCH1 mutants, Th2 and pancreatic contexts), whereas neighbours cover receptor processing and signal transmission to the nucleus.

qualifier: hyaluronan breakdown and ectodomain shedding control
name: Matrix and hyaluronan catabolism with metalloprotease and shedding regulation
rationale: Members cover collagen/elastin/hyaluronan degradation, MMP activation, endopeptidase regulation and membrane ectodomain proteolysis, distinguishing it from neighbours on collagen/elastic fibre synthesis or fibrinolysis-linked adhesion.

core: FGF receptor activation and downstream signalling
name: FGFR1/2 activation, activating mutants and adaptor cascades
rationale: Members are FGFR ligand binding, activating mutants and FRS/SHC/PI3K/PLC cascades centred on FGFR1 and FGFR2, which distinguishes it from neighbours built around FGFR3 signalling and FGFR2 splicing.

name: Matrix and fibrin clot proteolysis with integrin adhesion
rationale: Members combine MMP/collagen/elastin degradation with plasminogen activation, fibrinolysis, platelet degranulation and integrin adhesion, separating it from contact-activation/kallikrein and hyaluronan/ectodomain-shedding neighbours.

qualifier: neurotrophin activation and proximal adaptor pathways
name: TrkB activation by neurotrophins and proximal adaptor signalling
rationale: All members are NTRK2 activation by BDNF/NT-3/NT-4 and its immediate FRS2/3, PLCG1, RAS and PI3K signalling, unlike neighbours on NTRK3, CDK5/RAC1 branches or downstream CREB/ERK5 events.

qualifier: glycerol, urea and fatty acid transport
name: Thermogenic fat with glycerol, urea and fatty acid transport
rationale: Members join cold- and diet-induced thermogenesis and fatty acid cycling with aquaglyceroporin glycerol/urea/amide and fatty acid transport, distinguishing it from neighbours on brown/beige adipocyte differentiation or plain aquaporin water transport.

name: Granulocyte lineage differentiation and neutrophil granule programme
rationale: Members centre on neutrophil, eosinophil and mast cell differentiation, G-CSF/GM-CSF responses and neutrophil antimicrobial granule modules, distinguishing it from monocyte/macrophage CSF1, RUNX1-driven or erythroid-megakaryocytic neighbours.

name: Social, mating and drinking behaviour including ethanol response
rationale: All members are organism-level motivated behaviours (mating, parental, aggressive, drinking, ethanol response); drinking/ethanol separate it from reproductive-physiology, sleep and stress-response neighbours.

name: Postsynaptic glutamate receptor clustering and enhanced synaptic transmission
rationale: Members concern AMPA receptor clustering, diffusion trapping and localisation together with positive regulation of glutamatergic/GABAergic transmission and gating behaviours, unlike neighbours on receptor endosomal trafficking, presynaptic kainate function or NMDA signalling.

qualifier: aromatic, histidine, threonine and pyrimidine degradation
name: Amino acid catabolism spanning aromatics, histidine, threonine and pyrimidines
rationale: Members are amino acid metabolism focused on Phe/Tyr, His, Thr, Pro and glycine/glyoxylate catabolism plus pyrimidine nucleobase breakdown; histidine and pyrimidine catabolism distinguish it from the broader central amino acid neighbours.

name: Proteasome assembly and ubiquitin-independent degradation for cross-presentation
rationale: Members concern proteasome assembly and ubiquitin/ATP-independent proteasomal degradation feeding soluble antigen cross-presentation and CD8 T cell homeostasis, unlike neighbours on MHC I loading, ubiquitin-dependent degradation or viral receptor downregulation.

name: Keratinocyte and melanocyte proliferation–differentiation control in skin
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and apoptosis plus melanocyte proliferation, anagen and sebaceous gland development, distinguishing it from cornification/barrier, wound healing and melanin synthesis neighbours.

qualifier: postsynaptic receptor internalisation and vesicle recycling
name: Endosomal recycling of postsynaptic receptors and synaptic vesicles
rationale: All three members concern endosome-based internalisation/relocalisation of postsynaptic receptors and endosomal synaptic vesicle recycling, unlike neighbours on postsynaptic assembly, synapse structural plasticity or clathrin-mediated vesicle endocytosis.

core: Amino acid and organic acid catabolism
qualifier: gluconeogenic carbon flow and glycine conjugation
name: Amino acid catabolism linked to gluconeogenesis and glycine conjugation
rationale: Members span amino acid (aromatic, glutamate/aspartate/alanine, glycine, proline) and organic acid metabolism with xenobiotic glycine conjugation and BH4; gluconeogenesis/oxaloacetate distinguishes it from urea-cycle, sulfur/glutathione and TCA neighbours.

name: Renin–angiotensin system with angiotensin and kinin peptide processing
rationale: Members cover renin–angiotensin regulation of blood volume and pressure with angiotensinogen processing and bradykinin/neuropeptide catabolism, distinguishing it from vasodilatory, endothelin, natriuretic and glomerular neighbours.

name: Epidermal and ectodermal appendage development including cornification
rationale: Members span epidermal keratinocyte differentiation, cornified envelope and barrier formation and hair follicle, nail, sebaceous, mammary and papilla development, unlike pigmentation, tooth/inner ear or intestinal epithelium neighbours.

name: Mitochondrial translation initiation, elongation and termination
rationale: All members are the core steps of mitoribosomal translation, distinguishing it from neighbours on respiratory complex assembly, tRNA aminoacylation, mitochondrial transcription or mitoribosome assembly and RNA processing.

qualifier: membrane cargo sorting and basal body docking
name: Ciliary cargo targeting, transition zone and basal body docking
rationale: Members concern targeting of membrane cargo to the cilium (BBSome, ARL13B, VxPx, myristoylated proteins), transition zone localisation and basal body anchoring, as opposed to intraflagellar transport or photoreceptor neighbours.

qualifier: by RNA polymerases I, II and III, including HIV
name: Transcription initiation, pausing and elongation by all three RNA polymerases
rationale: Members cover initiation, promoter escape, pausing, elongation and termination by Pol I (with rDNA control and early rRNA cleavage), Pol II (including HIV Tat elongation and capping) and Pol III, unlike neighbours on splicing/RNA decay, translation or Pol II regulatory factors alone.

name: Cholinergic transmission through nicotinic acetylcholine receptors
rationale: Members cover acetylcholine metabolism and secretion, neuromuscular transmission and Ca2+/Na+-permeable nicotinic receptors, distinguishing it from muscarinic/serotonin, choline transporter and NMJ assembly neighbours.
